description: Cargo is a logistics marketplace that brings together the fragmented market of shipping, logistics and transport services. Our mission is to create a single platform providing end-to-end logistics solutions that customers can trust and rely on. We aim to solve the current inefficiencies of the marketplace by offering instant access to qualified cargo carriers, more transparency, and more competitive prices.
